title: 2026 ONS Environmental Accounts to DUKES energy bridge QA controls

facts.source_fact: The ONS energy bridging table describes the relationship between UK Environmental Accounts energy use and DUKES for 1990 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve both accounting frameworks and bridge direction.

facts.source_fact: The current energy bridge was released on 5 June 2026.

facts.expected_handling: Reject years outside the stated series unless a newer source is used.

facts.source_fact: ONS exposes a current downloadable spreadsheet and retains superseded versions.
facts.expected_handling: Record file vintage and do not mix editions.

facts.source_fact: ONS notes that initial estimates may be revised as further data become available.
facts.expected_handling: Treat later revisions as expected version changes.

facts.source_fact: ONS notes that revisions may also result from changes in methods or systems.
Scheduled revisions are distinguished from genuine errors, which are corrected and announced.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label every revision as an error correction.

facts.source_fact: UK Environmental Accounts measure environmental impacts and the relationship between the environment and economic activity.
facts.expected_handling: Keep environmental-account context separate from operational meter data.

facts.source_fact: The energy bridge is an energy-use reconciliation product, not itself a direct greenhouse-gas emissions measurement dataset.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute bridge energy values for measured emissions without an explicit conversion source.

facts.source_fact: The national bridge does not provide parcel-level, installation-level or vessel-level measurements.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer local energy or emissions values from the national bridge.

guard_patterns.handling: Require Environmental Accounts versus DUKES framework label.
Distinguish data, method and error revisions.
Keep energy use distinct from GHG emissions.
Preserve source energy units before any transformation.
Retain ONS bridge and release provenance.
Use bridge adjustments rather than summing overlapping frameworks.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
